verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de documents a REST API with endpoints for incorporation, notarization, translation, tax and trade registration, plus HMAC-signed webhooks and an llms.txt. Nothing in the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language, and no OpenAPI spec was found from which one could be generated. Official SDKs are a fair question for an API-driven SaaS, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none.
